properties.description:
The user reviews the separate graph-editing proposal artifact in Review → Changes and annotates its document and images. Review the table of contents, progressively disclosed detail, interaction mockups and operation-by-operation impact analysis, including invariant failures and effects on other relations.

Iterate on the artifact until the user approves the UI behavior, technical boundaries and acceptance criteria. Preserve candidate versions and linked feedback through the supported review workflow; task completion and discussion are not approval. Keep the original task brief separate from the proposal.

Development remains gated on this review passing. The review surface must accept this chosen artifact form without making it mandatory for all future proposals.
properties.title: Review and refine the graph-editing proposal
